tickerText: [TENNIS] Fall tour shifts to Almaty, Brussels and Lyon on the ATP side and Ningbo plus Osaka on the WTA, with Duckworth, Mannarino and Kukushkin through Almaty’s round of 32 and Bencic–Ostapenko among Tuesday’s Ningbo headliners • [SQUASH] PSA Gold Silicon Valley Open opens at Squash Zone in Redwood City with $260,000 equal prize money and world No. 1s Diego Elias and Nour El Sherbini topping the draws for opening-round play Tuesday • [BADMINTON] YONEX French Open launches at Arena Grand Paris as An Se-young starts her Super 750 title defense against Amalie Schulz and Alex Lanier meets China Masters winner Jason Gunawan in a home-crowd spotlight • [PICKLEBALL] Carvana PPA Tour heads to Kai Tak Arena for the Hang Seng Bank Hong Kong Slam after Virginia Beach crowned Kate Fahey and John Lucian Goins and first-time doubles champs Schupp and Martinez Vich • [TABLE TENNIS] ITTF-ATTU Asian Championships day two in Tashkent stacks men’s singles preliminaries from Wang–Thakkar to Prasongpol–Togami as team group matches roll on toward Astana 2027 qualifying

newsItems.title: French Open Paris Launch
newsItems.excerpt: The YONEX French Open Super 750 moves to Arena Grand Paris with An Se-young opening her title defense against Amalie Schulz, Kunlavut Vitidsarn facing Toma Junior Popov, and seventh seed Alex Lanier battling Jason Gunawan in front of the home fans.

newsItems.title: Hong Kong Slam Begins
newsItems.excerpt: The PPA Tour’s 1,500-point Hang Seng Bank Hong Kong Slam runs Oct. 19–25 at Kai Tak Arena, the next stop after Virginia Beach where Kate Fahey doubled in singles and mixed and John Lucian Goins claimed men’s singles gold.

newsItems.title: Almaty and Ningbo Tuesday
newsItems.excerpt: ATP Almaty round-of-32 winners include James Duckworth, Adrian Mannarino and wild card Mikhail Kukushkin, while WTA action continues in Ningbo and Osaka with early-round results and a Bencic–Ostapenko Ningbo clash on the card.

newsItems.title: Asian Champs Day Two
newsItems.excerpt: The 29th ITTF-ATTU Asian Championships in Tashkent move into a full men’s singles schedule—Wang Chuqin versus Manav Thakkar among the featured matchups—while men’s and women’s team group play continues through Oct. 25.
